"Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. David speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

FUSION REACTOR: the pellet goes in — properly, inside you. A warm hum starts behind your ribs and settles. You will never be hungry again. One reactor per world: yours. It does not come out. (The System is DELIGHTED. That should worry you.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (11/8/4), with 5 wave-4 fought, 5 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
The table notes 1 ascension from one village — its terms improve accordingly. Nobody has ever seen that before.

The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Ella's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
Something moves out there — The Audit.
You turn to leave — behind you, The Audit stirs.
